Release position

The core flows work. First-run onboarding and loading are the weak points.

A visual review, not a code-change report.

Twelve surfaces were reviewed with Playwright at 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900, including the live auth page. The account was freshly created and onboarding was skipped, so the audit reflects a new user as well as the empty-state system.

Verdict: the visual system is coherent in Settings, Account, Chat privacy, and the auth page. The failures are concentrated in onboarding and the first Home load, plus a set of small chrome/empty-state drifts.

Method

Playwright + Chrome, semantic tree navigation, screenshots, DOM/geometry measurements.

Evidence

Live pages, 390/1440 captures, console timing, and source references.

Limits

No iOS build; no physical device pass; deck was reached but not swiped for every card.

Severity definitions

High

Blocks comprehension or first-run trust. Fix before release.

Medium

Visible inconsistency on a common path. Fix in the next pass.

Low

Copy or composition polish. Batch with adjacent work.

Info

Working surface recorded as evidence, not a defect.

How to read this report. Each finding has an ID (V-01 to V-08), a severity, measured evidence, a likely root cause, and a recommendation. Page 10 orders the fixes by user impact. Screenshots come from the current build; no source files were changed in this pass.

V-01 / onboarding

The role cards fill the page with empty space.

High severity · step 1 of 4

At 390 × 844 the three role cards run from about 107 px to 757 px — roughly 650 px tall and 105 px wide. The icon and label sit near the bottom third, leaving about 358 px of empty card above and 227 px below. It reads as three empty columns, not three choices.

What the user sees
  • Card top: ~107 px; card bottom: ~757 px.
  • Card width: ~105 px; gap: 6 px.
  • Icon/label near 465–530 px.
  • Continue and “Do this later” stay pinned at 768/818 px.

Root cause: onboarding_scaffold.dart:140 gives the step body an Expanded(Center(child)); the role row then lets each AnimatedContainer fill the available height. The card has no content-height constraint.

Recommendation
  • Constrain the role group to a content height (about 150–190 px) or use IntrinsicHeight.
  • Center the row vertically as a group, not each card to the page.
  • At narrow widths, consider three compact horizontal cards or a 2 + 1 grid.
  • Keep the primary button area unchanged.
Measured vs target
AttributeNowTarget
Card height~650 px≤ 200 px
Card width~105 px≥ 160 px
Empty card above~358 px0 px
Group vertical centerpage centercontent center

Severity: High. This is the first substantive screen after login and the most visibly broken layout in the audit.

Option A

Content-height cards, centred as a group. Smallest change.

Option B

Two cards on top, one full-width below. Best for narrow screens.

Option C

Full-width horizontal rows with icon at left. Most scannable.

V-02 / first load

Home shows a giant skeleton for 10–12 seconds.

High severity · For You

The fresh account lands on a 328 × 690 px grey skeleton with the copy “Loading recommendations”. The deck only appears after roughly 10–12 seconds. Console output confirms two match requests and 14 people, so the data path works — the feedback does not.

Measured

Skeleton card 328 × 690. Deck 328 × 690. No horizontal overflow.

Timing

Data arrived after ~12 s; no visible timeout or retry before that.

Root cause

home_page.dart:774 shows the skeleton while _loading; the fetch has no short timeout or progressive state.

Recommendation: add a request timeout and a staged state: skeleton for ~1.5 s, then “Still looking…” with a retry, then empty/error. Cache the previous deck and render it immediately on return.

Why it matters: a new user’s first impression is a blank grey card. The deck itself is visually strong once it appears.

Observed load timeline

0-2 s

Full-card skeleton, no progress label beyond "Loading recommendations".

2-4 s

No change; the screen still reads as broken or empty.

4-10 s

No retry or fallback. The skeleton remains the only feedback.

~12 s

Deck appears with 14 people. The data was available after two match calls.

V-03 / empty states

The same empty state sits at three different heights.

Medium severity · Chats, Requests, Activity

Chats centers its ghost around y ≈ 500 px. Requests places the same ghost around y ≈ 700 px. Activity has no illustration at all and centers its text around y ≈ 430 px. The patterns are related but not one system.

Difference

Chats and Requests use the same ghost asset but different layout containers. Activity uses a different component entirely.

Recommendation

Create one EmptyState widget: optional illustration, one heading, one body, one action, centered in the remaining viewport with the same 32 px horizontal inset.

Target: Chats, Requests, Activity, Pals, Activity filters, and Browse empty states should share the same vertical rhythm and action placement.

V-04 / profile

The header grows around the name instead of clamping it.

Medium severity · Profile and Account

The test account’s display name wraps onto two lines and pushes “Edit” against the first line. The avatar is a 95 px circle, and the Skills to Learn / Skills to Teach sections render as large empty cards with only a heading.

What is wrong
  • Name has no line clamp or ellipsis.
  • Edit is vertically aligned to the first line, not the header block.
  • Empty skills cards have no empty-state copy or CTA.
  • Avatar dominates the card at 95 px.
Recommendation
  • Clamp the name to one line with ellipsis (or a fixed two-line box).
  • Place Edit at the top-right of the card, independent of wrapping.
  • Reduce avatar to 72–80 px.
  • Empty skills: “Add skills” action inside the section.

Note: the long email is test data, but the layout must survive a 25-character name. It currently changes the card height.

V-05 / chrome

The trailing icons are close, but not the same system.

Medium severity · page chrome

The rightmost action is centered at 350 px on Browse and Profile and 352 px on Home, Chats, and Requests. The target is 48 px on some bars and 44 px on others. The 2 px drift is small, but it is visible when moving between tabs.

V-06 / V-07

Two content edges still need work.

Medium + low · Browse and Settings

Browse scrolls its last row under the floating bottom navigation. There is no visible bottom inset, so a category looks cut off even though the page can scroll. Notifications ends mid-section at 844 px: “Quiet hours” is below the fold with no bottom breathing room.

Browse fix

Add bottom padding equal to the nav height + 16 px to the scrollable list, or make the nav part of the layout rather than an overlay.

Settings fix

Use the same 24 px section rhythm and a 24–32 px bottom inset. Keep “Quiet hours” visible as a section start, not a clipped fragment.

Pattern: both are bottom-inset problems, not hierarchy problems. A shared page scroll padding token would close them.

V-08 / low findings

Small copy and composition issues.

Low severity · multiple

Copy
  • Profile: “Pal 0” should be “0 Pals” or “Pals 0”.
  • Onboarding: “Step 1 of 4 - Role” uses a hyphen; use an en dash or a stacked label.
  • Activity: empty state has no illustration while Chats and Requests do.
Composition
  • Home media: the card image is extremely cropped (DRAFT fills the frame); choose a focal point or a softer fit for portrait media.
  • Auth: the browser form is consistent at 390 and 1440; no finding.
  • Shell: 1440 keeps the 480 px centred column; no overflow.

What works

Auth page

Form, inline errors, light/dark, and 390/1440 all hold. The reset page is the strongest surface in the audit.

Settings system

Settings, Account, Notifications, and Chat privacy share the same row rhythm and icon language.

Chrome

Pushed pages start titles at 64 px; root tabs at 16 px. The bottom nav is consistent across tabs.

Remediation

Fix the first-run experience before polishing the edges.

Ordered by user impact

OrderFindingActionEffort
1V-01Constrain RoleCardGroup height; center the group, not the cards. Add a 2 + 1 layout for narrow screens.Small
2V-02Add a short fetch timeout and staged loading state; cache the last deck; show Retry after ~4 s.Medium
3V-03Extract one EmptyState widget and apply it to Chats, Requests, Activity, Pals, and filters.Small
4V-04Clamp the name, anchor Edit, reduce avatar, add “Add skills” to empty sections.Small
5V-05Replace hand-rolled trailing actions with AppChrome.iconAction and one 48 px target.Small
6V-06/V-07Add shared bottom scroll padding; use it on Browse and Settings.Small
7V-08Copy pass: “0 Pals”, step label, Activity illustration, media fit.Small

Acceptance frame: the role screen should read as three choices, not three empty columns; Home should never show a blank skeleton for more than ~4 s without a retry path; every empty state should share one vertical rhythm.

Verification
  • Playwright at 390/1440, light/dark.
  • Measure role card height ≤ 200 px.
  • Measure rightmost icon center = 350 px.
  • Measure empty-state center within ±12 px.
  • Home first deck < 4 s or explicit retry.

Screenshots and measurements in this report were captured from the current build at localhost:5317 and the live auth page at palturo.app on 5 November 2026.
